meta.name: moddle
meta.tagline: Because your GPU has 16 GB, not infinite.
meta.note: VRAM figures are estimates for weights only unless a context is given. KV cache scales with context length. Measured throughput varies by runtime, driver, and settings.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.summary: Qwen's current 27B flagship for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with vision and thinking.
models.why: The strongest generalist you can self-host in this class. With EXL3 quants and int4 KV cache it stays fully resident on 16 GB, at a 176K context with images.

quants.note: Floor for 12-16 GB. ~229K ctx with images; quality is fair.
Recommended. ~176K ctx with images; good quality.
Very good; text-only at ~78K ctx on 16 GB.
llama.cpp path with fp16 KV; smaller context.

kit.name: Simplex one-click install
kit.note: Windows/Linux installer that picks the right EXL3 quant for your card, downloads it, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and opens a chat UI.

models.name: Qwen3.5-9B
models.summary: Multimodal 9B from the Qwen3.5 family, balancing quality and speed with a 256K context.
models.why: The new default 9B: fits fully at Q6 with a long context and handles text, images, tools, and thinking.

models.name: Qwen3.5-27B
models.summary: The larger Qwen3.5 multimodal model for when 9B is not enough.
models.why: A clear quality step up. Q3 keeps it resident; Q4 needs light offload.

models.name: Qwen3.6-27B
models.summary: Qwen3.6 upgrades agentic coding and thinking preservation over earlier Qwen generations.
models.why: A strong agentic/coding generalist at 27B when you can spare the VRAM for offload.

models.name: Qwen3-8B
models.summary: The dense 8B member of the Qwen3 family with switchable thinking mode.
models.why: Runs fully at Q8 with room to spare. A great fast daily driver or second model alongside a bigger one.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B
models.summary: Gemma 4 blends strong reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding at 12B.
models.why: Fits fully at Q6 with a 256K context. The best all-round Gemma for this card.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B (MoE)
models.summary: Gemma 4's MoE flagship: 25B total with only 3.8B active per token.
models.why: Near-frontier Gemma quality at small-model speed. Light offload is barely noticeable for a MoE.

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash
models.summary: Zhipu's 30B-A3B MoE aimed at lightweight deployment and efficiency.
models.why: The strongest model in the 30B class with tools and thinking, and MoE keeps offload cheap.

models.name: Magistral 24B
models.summary: Mistral's small, efficient reasoning model with transparent thinking.
models.why: Dedicated reasoning at 24B that fits fully at Q4. Great for math and multi-step problems.

models.name: LFM2-24B-A2B
models.summary: Liquid AI's hybrid MoE built for on-device deployment with only 2B active parameters.
models.why: Fits fully and runs extremely fast. Ideal for always-on assistants on modest hardware.

models.name: Ministral 3 14B
models.summary: Mistral's edge-focused Ministral 3 family, with a 256K context and vision at 14B.
models.why: Fits fully at Q6 with a 256K context and tool use. A compact, capable multilingual workhorse.

models.name: Devstral Small 2 24B
models.summary: A coding-agent model built to explore codebases, edit multiple files, and use tools.
models.why: The best local software-engineering agent in this class. Tight at Q4, but worth it for agentic coding.

models.name: Qwen3-VL-8B
models.summary: The current Qwen vision-language model, strong on documents, charts, grounding, and video.
models.why: Runs fully at Q8 with a 256K context. The new default vision model for a 16 GB card.

models.name: Qwen3-14B
models.summary: Dense 14B generalist with switchable thinking mode and strong multilingual and reasoning performance.
models.why: The best all-round dense model that fits fully at Q5/Q6 on 16 GB. Punches far above its size.

quants.note: Tight; use short contexts or light offload.

models.name: Mistral Small 3.1 24B
models.summary: 24B instruction model with 128K context, tool calling, and vision support.
models.why: The largest dense model that still fits fully at Q4_K_M with room for a real context window.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B
models.summary: Google's 12B open model with vision and a 128K context window, tuned for helpful assistant behavior.
models.why: Great quality-per-gigabyte and multimodal out of the box. Comfortable at Q6_K.

quants.note: Very light, lots of context room.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.summary: OpenAI's open-weight MoE designed to run in ~16 GB with MXFP4 and a 128K context.
models.why: Purpose-built for this class of hardware. MoE keeps it extremely fast while fitting fully.

quants.note: Native format. Fits with long context.

models.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
models.summary: MoE with only 3B active parameters, giving 30B-class quality at small-model speed.
models.why: The best quality-per-token on this list. Runs fast even when a few layers spill to system RAM.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B
models.summary: Distilled reasoning model that thinks step-by-step before answering.
models.why: Strong chain-of-thought reasoning that fits fully at Q5. Great for math and logic.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B
models.summary: The dependable 8B baseline with a 128K context and a huge ecosystem.
models.why: Maximum headroom: run it at Q8 with a long context and still have VRAM to spare.

quants.note: Exactly at the limit; not worth it.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B
models.summary: Dedicated coding model with strong fill-in-the-middle and repo-level ability.
models.why: The best fully-resident coding model on 16 GB. Ideal for editor copilots and agents.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B
models.summary: MoE coding model with agentic tool use and a huge native context.
models.why: Near-frontier coding quality at 3B active speed. The best coding agent you can self-host here.

models.name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite
models.summary: MoE coding model that fits fully and supports 338 programming languages.
models.why: Excellent coding quality while staying entirely in VRAM at Q5. Great long-context repo work.

models.name: Codestral 22B
models.summary: Mistral's code specialist with strong completion and 80+ language coverage.
models.why: Fits fully at Q4 and produces clean, idiomatic code across many languages.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B
models.summary: Lightweight coding model that leaves VRAM free for long contexts and other tools.
models.why: Perfect for always-on editor autocomplete or when you want to run a second model alongside.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL-7B
models.summary: Compact vision-language model strong at documents, charts, and grounding.
models.why: Runs fully at Q8 with a long context. The default vision model for 16 GB.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL-32B
models.summary: Large vision-language model with top-tier document and chart reasoning.
models.why: The strongest vision model you can run with partial offload. Slow but capable.

models.name: Llama 3.2 11B Vision
models.summary: Meta's 11B multimodal model for image reasoning and captioning.
models.why: Fits fully at Q6 and pairs well with the Llama ecosystem and tooling.

models.name: MiniCPM-V 2.6
models.summary: Compact vision model that excels at OCR and multi-image understanding.
models.why: Best-in-class OCR per gigabyte. Fits fully at Q8 and handles dense documents.

models.name: Gemma 3 27B
models.summary: Google's 27B multimodal model with a 128K context and strong reasoning.
models.why: A capable multimodal generalist at Q4. Dense KV cache means context is a real constraint.

models.name: SDXL / SDXL-Turbo
models.summary: The workhorse 1024px image model with a massive ecosystem of LoRAs and ControlNets.
models.why: Fast and extremely flexible. Runs comfortably on 16 GB with room for high-res upscaling.

models.name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
models.summary: Distilled 4-step FLUX variant with excellent prompt following and text rendering.
models.why: Near-FLUX quality in a few steps. Fits fully at fp8; the best fast image model here.

models.name: FLUX.1 [dev]
models.summary: The flagship open FLUX model with the best prompt adherence and realism.
models.why: Top-tier quality at Q8/tight. Use GGUF quants to fit and accept slower, bigger steps.

runtimes.comfyui: FLUX.1-dev GGUF Q8 + t5xxl fp8 + clip_l

models.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium
models.summary: Balanced MMDiT model optimized for consumer hardware at 1024px.
models.why: Fast, high quality, and light. A great complement to SDXL when you want better text.

models.name: Wan 2.1 T2V-1.3B
models.summary: Lightweight text-to-video model that can run on consumer GPUs.
models.why: One of the few real video generators that fits 16 GB. Short clips at 480p.

models.name: LTX-Video 2B
models.summary: Real-time-oriented video model that generates clips quickly.
models.why: Fast video on 16 GB with a lean footprint, good for experiments and img2vid.

models.name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
models.summary: Distilled Whisper with near-large accuracy at 8x the speed.
models.why: The best speed/accuracy tradeoff for local transcription. Tiny VRAM footprint.

models.name: Whisper large-v3
models.summary: The reference open speech-to-text model with strong multilingual accuracy.
models.why: When accuracy matters most. Runs via faster-whisper well within 16 GB.

models.name: Kokoro-82M
models.summary: Tiny, high-quality text-to-speech with multiple voices and fast synthesis.
models.why: Best-in-class TTS per byte. Leaves almost all your VRAM free for other models.

models.name: XTTS-v2
models.summary: Multilingual TTS with voice cloning from a short reference clip.
models.why: Great voice cloning and 17 languages, and it fits easily in VRAM.

models.name: Chatterbox
models.summary: Expressive open TTS with emotion control and zero-shot voice cloning.
models.why: Lifelike, emotive speech that fits comfortably and is easy to run locally.

models.name: BGE-M3
models.summary: Multilingual, multi-granularity embedder supporting dense, sparse, and ColBERT retrieval.
models.why: One model for dense + lexical + late-interaction retrieval. The RAG default.

models.name: Qwen3-Embedding-4B
models.summary: High-ranking text embedder with instruction-following and 100+ languages.
models.why: Top retrieval accuracy for hard corpora, with a long 32K context.

models.name: nomic-embed-text v1.5
models.summary: Compact 8192-context embedder with Matryoshka dimensions.
models.why: Tiny, fast, and good enough for most RAG. Ideal when VRAM is at a premium.

models.name: BGE Reranker v2-m3
models.summary: Multilingual cross-encoder reranker that sharply improves RAG precision.
models.why: Cheap to run and one of the biggest quality wins you can add to a local RAG stack.

models.name: Qwen3-Reranker-4B
models.summary: Instruction-aware reranker with strong multilingual and long-context precision.
models.why: Frontier reranking quality locally, and it shares the Qwen3 stack with your embedder.
